name: Juniper Hairon Canvas Weekender Bag
description:
Juniper is such a great bag for travel, and good looking too. Perfect for a weekend travel up North to the Adirondacks! Brown and white cowhide with a unique pattern. Embossed turquoise leather with a zipper front closure and a back zip pocket. Heavy brown canvas will hold all your travel needs. MYRA Logo fabric inside with plenty of room.  
Dimensions: Width: 20”, Height: 16”, Handle 15”, Depth 8.5”
Dry clean. Keep away from water
